channel.title: New York Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New York Daily News (nydailynews.com)

item.title: Yankees re-sign Paul Goldschimdt to one-year deal: reports
item.description: The Yankees are bolstering their bench with a familiar face as Paul Goldschmidt is returning to the Yanks on a one-year deal.

item.title: JD, Usha Vance showered with boos at Winter Olympics Opening Ceremony
item.description: Vice President JD Vance and the second lady were loudly booed at the 2026 Winter Olympics Opening Ceremony in Italy.

item.title: Video captures scuba, helicopter rescue of men who fell through ice in Jamaica Bay
item.description: Three men were rescued from Jamaica Bay after falling through the ice Friday, with NYPD scuba divers pulling them from the water and police helicopter pilots then flying them to safety, cops said.

item.title: Kid Rock invokes Kobe Bryant to address ‘haters’ ahead of TPUSA halftime show
item.description: The 55-year-old rapper will headline Turning Point USA's "All-American Halftime Show," billed as the right-wing organization's alternative to Bad Bunny.

item.title: Adam Sandler shoots down ‘insane’ story about daughter at Chanel store
item.description: A viral story about Adam Sandler's daughter being "publicly humiliated" in a Chanel boutique has turned out to be deepfake news.

item.title: The Milan Cortina Olympics officially open with a multi-site ceremony for a spread-out Winter Games
item.description: An unprecedented four-site, dual-cauldron opening ceremony got the Milan Cortina Olympics officially started Friday.

item.title: Pistons rout Knicks, 118-80, as Josh Hart (ankle) joins growing injury list
item.description: The Knicks are all banged-up, and a week's worth of rest and recovery is exactly what the doctor ordered at Madison Square Garden.

item.title: Cops release images of woman wanted for pushing subway rider onto Brooklyn tracks
item.description: The victim, a 58-year-old woman, was standing on the Manhattan-bound A train platform of the Lafayette Ave. station in Fort Greene when the suspect attacked her around 10 p.m. on Jan. 8, cops said.

item.title: St. John’s deals No. 3 UConn first Big East loss, closes gap in conference standings
item.description: The battle for the Big East just got much more interesting.

item.title: Asking Eric: Students give teacher gifts but her boyfriend objects
item.description: Dear Eric: I have been a preschool teacher for more than 20 years. There are a few times throughout the year where the kids and their parents give us gifts, which of course is optional. Those occasions are Christmas, Valentine’s Day, Teacher Appreciation Week and Graduation. I have never asked for, nor do I expect […]
